item.description: ☑️ Mark your calendar : EEN Invest 2026 (online) – 3 & 4 December 2026 ASD startups seeking funding and investors looking for European deal flow, this is exactly what EEN Invest 2026: Aerospace & Defence European Investment Forum brings together. Organised within the Enterprise Europe Network - able to reach 600 partner organisations and 3,000 experts in 50+ countries - and funded by the European Commission, this online event is designed to create concrete connections between innovators and specialized investors across Defence Tech, New Space, Dual-use technologies and Aeronautics. For startups & SMEs: 🔥 30-min bilateral meetings with specialized investors (VCs, business angels, corporate venture funds, family offices) 🌐 European-wide visibility for your company 💪 Pitch preparation support from September: deck reviews, mock juries, coaching 📈 Webinars on key European funding schemes (EDF, EUDIS, Horizon Europe…) For investors: 🔍 A curated pipeline of ASD startups and SMEs selected by EEN experts 🌍 Increased visibility within the European ASD investor ecosystem 📡 Deal flow across Defence Tech, New Space, dual-use technologies and Aeronautics 👉 Join us: https://lnkd.in/es5JE2WA Léo B. item.title: 📢 5 new large-scale European Defence Projects of Common Interest (EDPCIs) to strengthen industrial capacities of the Eur...
item.description: 📢 5 new large-scale European Defence Projects of Common Interest (EDPCIs) to strengthen industrial capacities of the European Union 👇 On 3rd July 2026, the European Commission proposed EDPCIs on five priority areas: drones and counter-drone systems; maritime and seabed defence; space; air and missile defence; as well as strengthening security along the EU's Eastern Flank. ▶️ EDPCIs which will provide a framework for EU countries to work together on large and complex defence initiatives improving the EU's ability to respond to shared security challenges, in line with NATO capability priorities. It is worth mentioning that Ukraine participates in four of the five projects. Next steps: After the adoption of the list of identified EDPCIs by the Council, those will become eligible to receive up to €325 million through EDIP through a dedicated procedure, enabling the projects’ initial deployment and lay the foundation for possible further funding via the upcoming European Competitiveness Fund. 🔎 More information and factsheets here: https://lnkd.in/dTKEcZSX Léo B. item.title: 📢 Defence and dual-use technologies become eligible to EIC funding instruments ▶️ As a result of an amendment to the EIC...
item.description: 📢 Defence and dual-use technologies become eligible to EIC funding instruments ▶️ As a result of an amendment to the EIC work programme 2026 adopted on 17 June 2026 by the Commission to implement the Defence Mini-Omnibus, the EIC Accelerator and STEP Scaleup will from now on support companies developing dual-use technologies. Start-ups and SMEs developing technologies with a focus on dual-use business cases, both civilian and defence applications, can apply for grants up to €2.5 million and equity investments up to €30 million. ▶️ At the same time, the EIC is launching a new €100 million EIC STEP Defence Scale Up call, allowing companies in the EU Member States and countries associated to Horizon Europe to receive up to €30 million in direct equity financing in sectors such as air and missile defence, drones and counter drones, and other critical defence technologies. 🔎 This is the first time any EU funding programme will ever invest direct equity in defence companies. They can apply from 30 June until 28 October 2026, and the results are expected in early 2027. 👉 More information on the dedicated news article: https://lnkd.in/egVPTANM Léo B. item.title: 📣 📣EDIP multiannual work programme adopted! 📍 Last week, the European Commission adopted a EUR 1.5 billion multiannual w...
item.description: 📣 📣EDIP multiannual work programme adopted! 📍 Last week, the European Commission adopted a EUR 1.5 billion multiannual work programme under the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP), a new EU initiative meant to strengthen and modernise Europe’s defence industry, ramp-up production capacity and secure Europe’s technological edge and resilience. 📍Over EUR 700 million of EDIP are dedicated to reinforcing European defence production. European companies can apply to receive funding for Industrial Reinforcement Actions (IRA) and increase their manufacturing capacities for energetic components, key electronic components, and defence platforms and end-products. Two additional calls dedicated to Ukraine (USI-IRA) aim at reinforcing Ukrainian defence industrial production capacity in terms of missiles, ammunition and bombs and (counter-)drone systems. 📍 Funding rates for successful projects are between 35-100% of eligible project costs, depending on the respective call. First calls will open on 30 April and the very first call on energetic components will already close mid-June. ➡️ More details on the new EDIP webpage (tutorial videos, factsheets, timelines, application process) => https://lnkd.in/ePQrbrWG Léo B. item.description: 🔎Eurobarometer Defence & Space results A new Eurobarometer survey released ahead of the Munich Security Conference shows Europeans’ growing perception of threat for their countries in the current international situation. Key findings of this survey are the following: 📍 68% of Europeans believe their country is under threat 📍52% of Europeans trust the EU to strengthen security and defence 📍74% of respondents approve of the EU’s current level of defence investment or believe that spending should be increased 📍EU space programmes are perceived as essential instruments for addressing defence and security, environment and climate and competitiveness. Léo B. item.title: 🚨 ▶️ Ownership Control Assessment (OCA) in EDF: new procedure The scope of the OCA procedure has been extended based on ...
item.description: 🚨 ▶️ Ownership Control Assessment (OCA) in EDF: new procedure The scope of the OCA procedure has been extended based on new Art. 136 of the Financial Regulation 2024/2509, leading to a more detailed and practice-oriented guidance, including: - Clarified ownership & control assessment criteria - Concrete examples, validity period, specific cases - Checks of intermediate ownership layers - New participants joining an action - Loss of eligibility scenarios - Expanded guidance on guarantees process - Clearer procedures for informing concerned entities 🔎 The new 2026 Ownership Control Declaration template must be used by the applicants and can be found under the Funding & Tenders Portal → EDF Reference Documents → Templates & Forms → Application Forms. The key difference compared to the old template is the difference between EU-controlled and non-EU controlled declarations (now more detailed, with non-EU countries identification, indication if those are eligible under specific calls). ▶️ Good to know: 📍 OCA validity period has been extended up to 36 months, 📍 OCA average process lasts 3 months, and work cannot begin before the entity (e.g. subcontractor, third party..) is validated (costs incurred not eligible for EU funding before) 📍 Ownership changes need to be notified immediately to DG DEFIS 👍 More information and tutorials available on the EDF official webpage: https://lnkd.in/ecnGG66U hashtag #EUDefenseIndustry Léo B. item.title: 🚨 The FSTP option under EDF: background and update for 2026 🚨 ▶️ FSTP (Financial Support to Third Parties) also known as...
item.description: 🚨 The FSTP option under EDF: background and update for 2026 🚨 ▶️ FSTP (Financial Support to Third Parties) also known as “cascade funding” is a measure used throughout different EU programmes to redistribute EU funding, implemented and managed by selected consortia via sub-calls for proposals. 📍 Under the European Defence Fund, it allows smaller players, the “third parties”, to gain faster & lighter access to funding with reduced financial risk towards faster innovation cycles and a first entry to the defence ecosystem. On the other hand, EDF consortia benefit from accelerated technology scouting and access to niche innovation as well as risk distribution to reach TRL maturity. 👉 2 ongoing EDF projects (MaJoR – EDF Work Programme 2023 (https://lnkd.in/ekFAcGUn) and Battleverse Project – WP 2024) have been and will be launching 2 sub-calls distributing up to €60K grants per selected third party. Under EDF 2025 WP, 2 calls required cascade funding to be included in the selected actions. 📍 Under the EDF 2026 Work Programme, FSTP is optional for all EDF calls. This can be decided at the proposal level among partners, and will have to be implemented according to the following rules: - FSTP budget represents a maximum of 5% of the total EU requested contribution, and each third party can receive up to EUR 60K - FSTP is implemented via min. 2 sub-calls per project where a minimum of 3 recipients per sub-call are selected for funding and to integrate an acceleration programme with a duration of max. 6 months. 🔎 Guidelines for FSTP under EDF: https://lnkd.in/exFNzStF Léo B.
